audited_source_corrections.action: Restored the carrier of a well-ordering to a subset of A, not a subset of its relation R.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof defines C using well-orderings of subsets B of A, but the transitivity paragraph later writes B subseteq R. R is a binary relation on B, so this reverses the intended carrier condition.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: மாறுநிலை நிறுவலில் ஒழுங்கமைவின் அடிக்கணம் A இன் துணைக்கணம் என்று சரிசெய்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the ill-typed carrier condition and relying only on the preceding definition of C.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Every witness (B,R) in C has B subseteq A, and each initial segment of B is again a subset of A.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the transitivity step use the actual defining condition of C, B subseteq A?

audited_source_corrections.action: Used two fresh ordinal variables and explicitly bounded the transported membership relation to the domain of f.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: After fixing an ordinal alpha as the domain of f, the relation comprehension reuses alpha as a varying index and does not state that its indices belong to dom(f). Read literally, f(alpha) is outside its domain.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: உறவின் மாறும் குறிகளாக xi, eta ஆகியவற்றை எடுத்து xi∈eta∈alpha என்ற ஆட்கள வரம்பை வெளிப்படையாகக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the ambiguous reused alpha and inferring the domain restriction only from definedness of f.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The injective f transports the membership well-order on the fixed ordinal alpha to its image B exactly by pairs (f(xi),f(eta)) with xi in eta in alpha.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is R now a well-defined relation on ran(f) isomorphic to membership on the whole fixed ordinal alpha?

audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced a nested equinumerosity expression between a proposition and M with the two intended equinumerosity claims for disjoint union and Cartesian product.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The closing example nests cardeq(A disjoint-sum B,A times B) as the first argument of another cardeq with M. The inner expression is a proposition, not a set whose size can be compared with M, and the intended AC statement concerns each operation separately.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: வெட்டாக் கூட்டுத்தொகையும் பெருக்கற்கணமும் ஒவ்வொன்றாக பெரிய கணம் M உடன் சமஎண்ணிக்கையுடையவை என்ற இரண்டு கூற்றுகளாகக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the ill-typed nested expression or only claiming that sum and product are equinumerous to each other.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: When A and B are infinite and comparable under Choice, both their disjoint union and their product have the size of the larger carrier, as the referenced theorem states.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Are both sum and product separately compared with the larger set M, with no proposition passed as a set argument?
